requirements: One status RPC per projector or reactor, automatic from existing app setup.
Authoritative committed checkpoints supply progress; optional observations must not replace them.
Configured PORTIA_SYSTEM_ADMIN_ROLE and authenticated principal role are sufficient; an existing operational authorization policy may further restrict access.
Status should stay useful when optional source or journal observations fail.
Diagnostic RPC failures must not stop domain processing.
Work is bounded; no full history scan.

provider_facts.fitz_expiry: The broker skips expired records without returning a withheld marker. Readable record offsets can be ascending with gaps, and exhausted page cursor may advance across expired records.
provider_facts.fitz_metadata: Resource metadata samples an exclusive head before a subsequent read; new records may be appended between those calls.
provider_facts.fitz_rpc_dispose: RpcWorkerRegistration.DisposeAsync swallows unsubscribe failures. UnregisterAsync does not swallow them and may be retried. Client retains local handler until unsubscribe succeeds, rejecting duplicate route registration.

configured_role_gate.instructions: Does ProcessorStatusAuthorizer require an authenticated principal holding the exact role selected by PORTIA_SYSTEM_ADMIN_ROLE?

mandatory_extra_policy.instructions: Does ProcessorStatusAuthorizer reject an otherwise authorized administrator when IOperationalAuthorizer is absent?

native_checkpoint_replacement.instructions: Can an adapter-provided progress Position replace the native checkpoint Position in the returned ProcessorStatus?

roster_before_checkpoint.instructions: Does ProcessorStatusHandler consult the event-sourced tenant directory before loading native processor progress?

noncontiguous_expiry_throws.instructions: Does CountProgressRecords throw when expiration leaves ascending readable offsets with a gap?

empty_page_zero_head.instructions: Can GetProgressAsync report source position zero for an exhausted empty broad-scope page whose cursor advanced across expired records?

concurrent_append_in_lower_bound.instructions: Can the resource lower-bound count include a record at or beyond the earlier sampled exclusive source head?

status_registration_escapes_retry.instructions: Can an exception from statusRpc.RegisterAsync escape before PortiaWorkloadService enters its processing retry loop?

failed_withdrawal_recoverable.instructions: Does the status registrar retain a native registration whose withdrawal failed so that it can retry withdrawal before reacquiring the same route?

caller_cancellation_preserved.instructions: Does ProcessorStatusHandler propagate caller cancellation instead of returning it as a source observation error?
